summary: Hyundai ABS Funding LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus for Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-B, a $2.187 billion term asset-backed securitization of auto loan receivables. The offering comprises seven classes of notes (Class A-1 through Class C) with fixed and floating rates, maturing from 2027 to 2033. Proceeds to the depositor total ~$2.182 billion after underwriting discounts. Credit enhancement includes a reserve account, excess interest, subordination, overcollateralization, and a yield supplement amount. This is a routine non-special-situation ABS issuance; no corporate event or restructuring is involved.
